text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide claimed victory in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn). Winning Ticket, who ran 
alongside her, praised her magnificent 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears naturally well up in Biwa Hayahide's 
eyes as she feels her own growth. She is 
no longer the girl who lost to her sister 
and suffered injuries in the past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To defeat her younger sister—Narita Brian— 
she and her Trainer had crafted a "winning 
formula."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only two months remained until the Arima 
Kinen, the ultimate test of her abilities.
